experiences.name: Mercado de San Juan Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Mexico City's most beloved gourmet markets, sampling exotic cheeses, fresh seafood tostadas, traditional tacos, and regional delicacies from across Mexico. Chat with local vendors and discover ingredients used in authentic Mexican cuisine.

experiences.name: Museo Nacional de Antropología
experiences.description: Visit one of the world's greatest anthropology museums, housing the famous Aztec Sun Stone and vast collections of pre-Columbian artifacts. Gain deep insight into Mexico's indigenous civilizations including the Aztec, Maya, and Olmec cultures.

experiences.name: Street Taco Crawl in Coyoacán
experiences.description: Wander through the bohemian neighborhood of Coyoacán, stopping at legendary taco stands and street food stalls. Try tacos de canasta, tlayudas, and elotes while soaking in the colorful colonial architecture and vibrant local atmosphere.

experiences.name: Frida Kahlo Museum (Casa Azul)
experiences.description: Tour the iconic Blue House where Frida Kahlo was born and lived, now a museum preserving her personal belongings, artwork, and studio. A deeply moving cultural experience that reveals the life and legacy of Mexico's most celebrated artist.

experiences.name: Traditional Mole Cooking Class
experiences.description: Join a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef in the Roma neighborhood, learning to prepare authentic mole negro, fresh salsas, and handmade tortillas. Includes a market visit to source fresh ingredients and a full sit-down meal at the end.
